reviews.comment: Dr. Zhe Zhang is an excellent professor. Her teaching style is clear, organized, and easy to follow, even for complex topics. She explains material in a way that makes it understandable and engaging. She is also supportive and responsive to students' questions. Overall, a great learning experience—highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: After saying only 3 attendance recorded, she then added another one right before spring break that she wasn't even there for. Also horribly boring

Good professor but the course content needs to be updated as soon as possible. A lot of the labs could be combined or more challenging, but honestly, I feel that I learned a lot from this course compared to my other GIS courses. If you put forth some effort on the group projects, you will learn a lot. Would 100% recommend this.

The class seems intimidating at first but is not as hard as it seems. There is plenty of coding but it is taught well and there are plenty of resources to comprehend the content. She does attendance checks randomly and there is weekly homework. The labs can be a little difficult at times but the instructions and rubric are clear and help.

The exams were pretty easy. Open note and lots of time. Labs were hard and confusing. The group project is pretty time consuming and can be hard if you suck at coding. She did a few attendance checks. Overall not too hard to get an A as long as you don't procrastinate too much on labs.

I absolutely loved having the privileged of taking GEOG478 with Dr.Zhang! Dr. Zhang is smart, caring and a great teacher. She would make you class interesting and interactive. I fell behind in her class but she reached out to me and help me get back on track and improve. Informs about opportunities.

Friendly, chill professor. Big group semester project, so be sure to stay on top of that. Lectures were clear and easy to follow. Graded work made of exams, weekly HW, project, and labs; labs are super easy thanks to the nice TA. 5 attendance checks throughout the semester.
